name: GnuDash
description: A web dashboard for visualizing and exploring GNUCash financial data.

paragraphs: A personal finance dashboard for GNUCash users. Upload your .gnucash file (SQLite or XML), explore and edit your finances — everything runs in your browser.
GnuDash is an independent, community project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the GNU Project or GNUCash.
Try it live — the app is served as a fully static site. Once the page loads, no data crosses your network. Your .gnucash file is read and queried entirely within your browser.
features: Net Worth — Track assets minus liabilities over time with trend charts
Income / Expenses — Sankey flow diagrams, category breakdowns (pie charts), monthly trend bars, and budget tracking in a single combined view
Cash Flow — Monthly inflow/outflow bars with net trend line, cash flow Sankey diagram, and budget vs actual
Investment Portfolio — Holdings table, allocation pie chart, performance metrics, price history, and portfolio value over time
Budget Tracking — Budget vs actual with expense/income tabs, YTD variance, drill-down by category, and unbudgeted spend detection

whatItDoes.text: A personal finance dashboard for GNUCash users. Upload your .gnucash file (SQLite or XML), explore and edit your finances — everything runs in your browser.

requirements.text: If you want the same book accessible from every device you use — phone, laptop, work machine — you can self-host GnuDash against your own Postgres database instead of relying on the per-browser OPFS cache.
